# Since the results only provide proportions, we'll work backwards from standard test scenarios
# A typical two-proportion z-test formula uses:
# z = (p1 - p2) / sqrt(p_pool * (1 - p_pool) * (1/n1 + 1/n2))
# where p_pool = (x1 + x2) / (n1 + n2)
